# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: one player on a ladder.
# map mp_ship, client-probes/probe_ladder under tools/run_probe.sh with +set
# probe_teleport 1, the client --probe-ladder 90 --save-ladder turn (recipe in
# crates/gsc/tests/fixtures/semantics/client-probes/README.md, probe_ladder).
# The gsc puts the player at a ladder's foot facing the rungs (mp_ship's hold
# ladder, or probe_spot's); the script starts 1500 ms after the first snapshot
# on the rungs. Phases: (name, ms, forward, right, pitch, yaw offset):
# ladder foot=4332,-93.125,58 yaw=90
#   up 1500 127 0 0 0
#   hang 500 0 0 0 0
#   turn-left 1500 0 0 0 160
#   hold-left 800 0 0 0 160
#   back-left 1000 0 0 0 0
#   turn-right 1500 0 0 0 -170
#   hold-right 800 0 0 0 -170
#   back-right 1000 0 0 0 0
#   up-turning 1500 127 0 -20 130
#   flick 150 0 0 0 -140
#   hold-flick 800 0 0 0 -140
#   back-flick 500 0 0 0 0
#   down 4000 -127 0 0 0
#   foot-turn 1500 0 0 0 160
#   foot-hold 800 0 0 0 160
# !cmd is a usercmd as it went on the wire (angles rebased on delta_angles);
# !snap the playerstate per snapshot, da= its delta_angles, view= its viewangles,
# lv= its vLadderVec. Floats exact.
[phase up]
